subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2024 · Mini Test 3 (Problem Solving & Staging)

questions.stem: A 2-year-old baby weighing 15 kg was brought to the hospital with a history of loose stools. He is afebrile, and there is no blood in his stools. The baby is lethargic. On examination, eyes are sunken and during the skin pinch test, the skin retraction took more than two seconds. On offering water the child doesn't show eagerness to drink and responds poorly. Which of the following is correct with respect to the treatment of dehydration in this child?
questions.stemHtml: A 2-year-old baby weighing 15 kg was brought to the hospital with a history of loose stools. He is afebrile, and there is no blood in his stools. The baby is lethargic. On examination, eyes are sunken and during the skin pinch test, the skin retraction took more than two seconds. On offering water the child doesn't show eagerness to drink and responds poorly. Which of the following is correct with respect to the treatment of dehydration in this child?

options.label: A
options.text: 600 ml to be given as IV in the first 1 hour

options.label: B
options.text: Zinc, antibiotics, and oral rehydration solution

options.label: C
options.text: 450 ml to be given as IV in the first half hour

options.label: D
options.text: 450 ml to be given as IV in the first 1 hour
